name: RLSplat
aliases: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: RLSplat is a resource-linear budget-controllable FF3DGS framework where representation size, inference latency, and peak memory all decrease linearly as the Gaussian budget B is reduced. It solves the problem that prior methods (EcoSplat, F4 Splat) predict a dense set of Gaussians and then prune/select, resulting in nearly constant latency and memory regardless of budget.
summary: RLSplat is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that generates exactly B Gaussians using a learned allocation policy and resource-linear decoder, ensuring inference latency and memory scale linearly with the requested budget.
